definitions: A layer of material applied to the surface of a wall or other structure for decoration or protection.
The collar, cuffs, and lapels of a uniform, especially when of a different color or material from the main body.
A lining or trim on a garment, especially at an edge or opening, to give it a neat finish.
examples: The building's exterior facings were made of polished granite.
The officer's uniform had red facings.
She added silk facings to the jacket.
